dataset.name: BMC/LHMC stage I LUAD discovery cohort (GSE273377)
dataset.description: Independent stage I lung adenocarcinoma discovery cohort with bulk exome-capture RNA sequencing and individual seven-year recurrence-free survival.
dataset.cohort_context: The source study profiled resected stage I lung adenocarcinomas from Boston Medical Center and Lahey Hospital and Medical Center. TRACE Explorer retains the 103 discovery-cohort tumors that passed the source transcript-integrity QC and have positive individual recurrence-free follow-up. The independent validation cohort from the same GEO series is registered separately and is never pooled with this dataset.

metadata.source_program: BMC/LHMC stage I LUAD vascular-invasion study
metadata.source_data_system: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus and Nature Communications source data
metadata.library_method: Exome-targeted bulk RNA-seq from FFPE resection tissue using Illumina TruSeq RNA Exome libraries and paired-end 50-nucleotide reads
metadata.endpoint_context: Source-defined seven-year recurrence-free survival after surgical resection
metadata.endpoint_caveat: The source data provide individual follow-up capped at 84 months and a binary RFS event field. TRACE Explorer preserves that definition and does not reinterpret the event as OS, DSS, DFI or PFI.
metadata.sample_selection_note: Only samples labeled discovery cohort and passed qc: TRUE in the pinned GEO SOFT are eligible. Every retained patient contributes one RNA profile.
metadata.clinical_evidence_note: The pinned CC BY source-data ZIP contains 192 individual discovery-cohort RFS records. GEO title linkage identifies all 108 sequenced discovery tumors; five source-QC failures are then excluded, leaving 103 endpoint-complete patients. The 84 source-data records without a GSE273377 RNA profile remain visible as unmatched evidence in the audit manifest.
metadata.overlap_note: The discovery and validation cohorts are independent source cohorts. They are exposed as separate datasets, and neither includes TCGA-LUAD, Uppsala GSE81089 or TRACERx samples used elsewhere in the publication.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the public GEO and CC BY source files in place. Redistribution of the source expression matrix remains disabled under the conservative repository policy.

samples.sample_role: Resected stage I lung adenocarcinoma FFPE tumor from the source discovery cohort

expression.label: GEO RSEM counts normalized to log2(CPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Pinned Ensembl release 108 GRCh38 annotation declared by the source study
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Symbols mapped from more than one source Ensembl row are excluded rather than combined without an unambiguous source-level rule.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer computes sample library sizes across all 62,703 pinned RSEM count rows, converts counts to CPM and applies log2(CPM + 1). It does not apply the source study's downstream ComBat-seq correction, avoiding leakage of source-defined comparison groups into a general-purpose survival layer.

endpoints.label: Seven-year recurrence-free survival
endpoints.event_definition: Recurrence event as encoded in the source seven-year RFS field
